newsitem.title: USA: Martin Lawrence plan offered by creditor.
newsitem.headline: Martin Lawrence plan offered by creditor.

text.p: Martin Lawrence Limited Editions Inc said that Chalk & Vermilion Fine Arts LLC and the Official Committee of Creditors Holding General Unsecured Claims have asked the company to support a plan of reorganization.

In a statement released late on Friday, Martin Lawrence, which filed Chapter 11 in December 1996, said it is still exploring alternatives, but absent a more beneficial option it will file the Chalk proposal with the Bankruptcy Court before April 16, 1997.

Under Chalk's plan, Chalk, the company's largest secured creditor, would exchange its $1.2 million debt for 100 percent of the equity of the reorganized company. The company said said $525,000 would be set aside for payment of general unsecured claims.
